description: This file implements a factory class for creating media frame writers, supporting different versions based on environment variables. It includes logic for version selection, error handling, and references to related media writer classes.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating media frame writer instances based on versioning.

classes.name: IMediaFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: Interface for media frame writer factory, providing a static method to get factory instance.

methods.name: IMediaFrameWriterFactory::getFactory
methods.description: Static method to obtain a shared pointer to the media frame writer factory.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterFactory::MediaFrameWriterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory, determining the metadata version from environment variables.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterFactory::createFrameWriter
methods.description: Creates a media frame writer object based on the current metadata version.
